maintenance_surface: Shared/public surfaces expose finished artifacts; teacher-only creation/management controls live under the declared local owner-tools root. The canonical Curriculum Control Panel does not expose a generic Maintenance tab.
local_owner_tools_rule: Algebra teacher-only controls such as Quick Check Builder, Checkpoint Builder, Teacher Practice Builder, Performance Task control/builder, Portfolio/email entry links, and future Set/Summative/Investigation builder controls live in the non-repository sibling _algebra_teacher_tools. Finished shareable curriculum products remain in course repositories.
portfolio_delivery_exception: Portfolio normal grading/state/report work is local under _portfolio_data and uses Student Data Tools.app to launch the localhost runtime. Google Drive is not canonical Portfolio state after migration. Live email delivery uses a current private Portfolio_Email_Sender_Package.zip built from local _portfolio_data; the Google Apps Script sender is transport-only and may use Drive only for transient package staging plus its private send log.
checkpoint_delivery_exception: Algebra personalized Checkpoint runs remain private state-informed workflows. The Checkpoint Builder is an owner-local non-repository tool under _algebra_teacher_tools; personalized student outputs/source maps must not be published to the shared course repository.
